_comment: Source of truth for `cascivo/prop-vocabulary`. Every row is a REAL wrong guess from a dated adopter report, paired with the prop that exists. `scripts/eslint-vocabulary/generate.ts` validates each row against registry.json — the `is` prop must exist on the component and the `wrote` prop must not — and emits src/prop-vocabulary.json, which the rule reads. Adding a row is a JSON edit; the rule needs no code. Keep this in sync with the near-miss table in docs/AI-RULES.md, which doc-api-drift.test.ts checks from the other side.

props.note: `tone` is the catalog's SEVERITY vocabulary (Status, Badge, Timeline, SideNav). Text emphasis is the boolean `muted`. For coloured text that means something, use Status or Badge.
DataTable renders a <table>, where "rows" is the domain word. Every other collection prop in the catalog is `items`.
`rows` is DataTable's word and only DataTable's.
A visual style enum is always `variant` — never shape/kind/type/appearance.

tupleHooks.note: `useTheme()` returns a tuple `[name, setTheme]`, like useState. The object shape `{ theme, setTheme }` is next-themes'.

defaultDirection.note: `Flex` defaults to `direction="vertical"` — unlike CSS, and unlike Chakra/MUI/Radix. With no `direction`, `justify`/`align` act on the block axis, so a row comes out as a centred column.
